city.name: Perseverance Holdings
city.motto: Every game played ten thousand times before it tips.
bylaws: Paper money only. Nothing here touches a real account.
The minimum bet is $5 and does not change.
Bets go only to the ten approved books. No desk may edit that list.
A new model replaces an old one only after it passes its test and the chairman approves.
Every check fails loudly. A desk that cannot verify its work says so.

bulletin.text: The city is now in 3D (drag to turn it, pinch to zoom) and shows each run live: which desks worked, in order, as soon as the run lands.
The buildings are open: tap one to see every worker, what arrives on the desk, what leaves, and a live chart of the work.
Staff Writer hired: the Daily Briefing publishes at 7am from Nov 17, with written editions at 7:22am, 2:41pm and 6:33pm.
Best Bets props are now sticky: a pick leaves only on a kill condition (injury, side flip, no longer +EV).
Paid odds plan: a Scout every 15 minutes, a Closer at every tip, prop refreshes four times a day, and a Backtester with its own historical-odds allotment.
Four Claude agents join in shadow: Newsroom, Skeptic, Strategist and Auditor. Their calls are graded before any of them can act.
The city now rests when nobody is working: an On shift panel, a live activity log, and desks fire only when they change something. Brighter 3D.

schedule.note: ~2pm ET in winter (3pm in summer) — NBA matchup props, early so plays are ready in the afternoon
~3:15pm ET in winter — props backup: only runs if the 2pm run was delayed or dropped
~6:57am ET in winter — Daily Briefing morning edition (refreshes research first if stale)
~9:40am ET — free research refresh: box scores, lineups, projections, trends
~4:45pm ET — free research refresh with updated lineups
~6:15pm ET in winter — pre-game refresh: late injuries, lineups, re-run all sims (free)
~8:45pm ET in winter — late-game refresh for 10pm+ West Coast tips: only games not yet started (free)
every 15 min, ~7pm-1am ET in winter — DraftKings live lines + sim from the live score (free)
every 30 min, ~1pm-7pm ET in winter — injury watch: re-price right away when a rotation player is ruled out or cleared (free)
Sundays ~3:23am ET — Backtester: historical closing lines (its own credit allotment)
